item.title: 【Albums (lossless)】DSF - The Doobie Brothers = Minute By Minute (MFSL SACD 2025. DSD64 + CD Layer)
item.description:
Hello everyone!
It's been a while, but I'm back with a new rip of a brand new SACD by MoFi!

Today I bring y'all:
The Doobie Brothers - Minute By Minute (DSD64 + CD Layer)

The SACD has been out for a week or so, but I couldn't find a rip of any of the layers from this Hybrid SACD; the worst part was that my copy got delayed at customs for a while! But I've finally got it with me at last.

Here you have it! I've already listened to it, and I must say that it is so frikin' good. Even better than my previous version-to-go, which was the AFZ Gold Disc.



Enjoy!

1.- Here to love you

4.- Dependin' on you
5.- Don't stop to watch the wheels
